summary: eXoZymes Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a firm-commitment underwritten offering of common stock and warrants. The offering consists of 592,270 shares and 292,135 warrants at $18.00 per unit (two shares plus one warrant), grossing ~$5.33M before commissions. MDB Capital is sole book-runner; Lucid Capital Markets is Qualified Independent Underwriter. Closing is expected June 9, 2026. Proceeds fund NCT business development, R&D, working capital. This is a routine capital raise via shelf registration, not a special situation.
